title: Anchor enrichment on write
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to build

When `sutra_remember` is called, the writing sutra instance enriches the lesson with pattern anchors and categories inferred from its workspace graph, before persisting. The agent provides text + location anchors (what it was editing); sutra fills in the rest.

Enrichment steps:
1. Location anchors stored as-is (agent-provided symbol name, file path)
2. Look up the file in the workspace index → get imports via `Db::imports_for_file()`
3. Infer import-pattern anchors from the file's import paths (e.g., file imports `rusqlite` → add `import:rusqlite` anchor)
4. Infer directory pattern from the file path (e.g., `crates/sutra-core/src/extract/` → directory anchor)
5. Infer categories from file language (→ `rust`/`dart`), import-derived technology tags, and component membership

This slice requires the anchor matching (sutra/153) and categories (sutra/155) slices to be complete so that enriched anchors and categories are meaningful.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Writing a lesson with only a symbol anchor auto-generates import-pattern anchors from the symbol's file
- [ ] Writing a lesson auto-generates a directory anchor from the file path
- [ ] Writing a lesson auto-infers language category from the file
- [ ] Writing a lesson auto-infers technology categories from imports
- [ ] Explicitly provided anchors/categories are preserved (enrichment adds, doesn't replace)
- [ ] Enrichment is best-effort — missing workspace data doesn't fail the write
- [ ] Tests: enrichment from imports, from directory, from language, explicit + inferred combination

## Blocked by

- sutra/153 — File glob + import pattern + directory anchor matching
- sutra/155 — Categories + cross-project filtering
- sutra/157 — 5x-review-2

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review: needs-attention → fixed in a690a9e.

Findings:
1. [high] crate::* anchor pollution — import_root returned "crate" for internal Rust imports, producing broad anchors. Fixed: skip crate/self/super/std roots.
2. [medium] ambiguous short symbol enrichment — resolve_symbol picked arbitrarily among multiple matches. Fixed: switched to resolve_symbol_diagnostic, only enrich Unique results.

Both findings have regression tests.
